summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose monthly distributions declared on July 31, 2026, for eight classes of common stock, with gross distributions of $0.1395 per share and net amounts ranging from $0.1207 to $0.1395 after stockholder servicing fees. The distributions are payable to stockholders of record on July 31, 2026, and will be paid on or about August 12, 2026, in cash or reinvested under the distribution reinvestment plan. This is a routine distribution announcement, not a special situation, and no M&A, tender, or strategic event is involved.
